name: menubar-with-icons
title: Menubar: With Icons
description: Add icons to menu items to make actions easier to scan.

files.content:
import { HugeiconsIcon } from "@hugeicons/react";
import File01Icon from "@hugeicons/core-free-icons/File01Icon";
import Folder01Icon from "@hugeicons/core-free-icons/Folder01Icon";
import HelpCircleIcon from "@hugeicons/core-free-icons/HelpCircleIcon";
import SaveIcon from "@hugeicons/core-free-icons/SaveIcon";
import Settings01Icon from "@hugeicons/core-free-icons/Settings01Icon";
import TrashIcon from "@hugeicons/core-free-icons/TrashIcon";

import {
  Menubar,
  MenubarContent,
  MenubarGroup,
  MenubarItem,
  MenubarMenu,
  MenubarSeparator,
  MenubarShortcut,
  MenubarTrigger,
  MenubarList,
} from "@/registry/erbium/ui/menubar";

export function MenubarIcons() {
  return (
    <Menubar className="w-72">
      <MenubarMenu>
        <MenubarTrigger>File</MenubarTrigger>
        <MenubarContent>
          <MenubarList>
            <MenubarItem>
              <HugeiconsIcon icon={File01Icon} />
              New File <MenubarShortcut hotkey="Mod+N" />
            </MenubarItem>
            <MenubarItem>
              <HugeiconsIcon icon={Folder01Icon} />
              Open Folder
            </MenubarItem>
            <MenubarSeparator />
            <MenubarItem>
              <HugeiconsIcon icon={SaveIcon} />
              Save <MenubarShortcut hotkey="Mod+S" />
            </MenubarItem>
          </MenubarList>
        </MenubarContent>
      </MenubarMenu>
      <MenubarMenu>
        <MenubarTrigger>More</MenubarTrigger>
        <MenubarContent>
          <MenubarList>
            <MenubarGroup>
              <MenubarItem>
                <HugeiconsIcon icon={Settings01Icon} />
                Settings
              </MenubarItem>
              <MenubarItem>
                <HugeiconsIcon icon={HelpCircleIcon} />
                Help
              </MenubarItem>
              <MenubarSeparator />
              <MenubarItem variant="error">
                <HugeiconsIcon icon={TrashIcon} />
                Delete
              </MenubarItem>
            </MenubarGroup>
          </MenubarList>
        </MenubarContent>
      </MenubarMenu>
    </Menubar>
  );
}
